chunks: 5698 - Muhammad ibn al-Fuḍayl narrated from Abū al-Ṣabbāḥ and ʿAmr ibn ʿUthmān, from al-Mufaḍḍal, from Zayd, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
Regarding the son of al-mulāʿanah, who inherits from him? He عليه السلام said: “His mother inherits from him.”

I said: “What do you say if his mother dies, and he inherits from her, then he dies—who inherits from him?” He عليه السلام said: “The agnatic relatives of his mother inherit from him, and he inherits from his maternal uncles.”

key_terms.ابْنِ الْمُلَاعَنَةِ: the son born from a case of liʿān (mutual cursing between spouses)
key_terms.عَصَبَةُ أُمِّهِ: the male-line kin of his mother’s side who inherit in this case

ai.seo_question: Who inherits from the son born through liʿān in Shia fiqh?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the inheritance of the child born through liʿān. It states that his mother inherits from him, and if he later dies after inheriting from her, the inheritance passes to his mother’s relatives; he also inherits from his maternal uncles.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.5698 - Muhammad ibn Al-Fudayl narrated from Abu Al-Sabbah and Amr ibn Uthman from Al-Mufaddal from Zayd from Abu Abdullah (as)

regarding the inheritance of the son of the cursed woman.
Imam (as) said: "His mother inherits from him."

I asked: "What if his mother dies, and he inherits from her, then he dies - who inherits from him?"
Imam (as) said: "The maternal relatives (Aṣaba) of his mother inherit from him, and he inherits from his maternal uncles."
